target.title: fix(channels): stop sends after delivery cancellation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where cancelling an outbound delivery while hooks or rendering were still running could still send a message afterward. Signal's chunked sender also received no cancellation signal from the delivery owner.

## Why This Change Was Made

The delivery abort signal now reaches both channel outbound adapters and message adapters, and delivery rechecks it after each pre-send async stage and immediately before a platform send.

## User Impact

Cancelled agent runs no longer produce late outbound messages after the user or runtime has cancelled them; channels that support cooperative cancellation receive the same attempt signal.

## Evidence

- Added a regression test that aborts inside the reply-payload hook and verifies the platform sender is never called.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/outbound/deliver.test.ts` passed: 138 tests.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- AI-assisted; one repository autoreview pass completed with no accepted findings.
